messages:
Priya (partnerships): Heads up — ACME Cloud says incoming POs are stuck because their marketplace requires a merchant_account field to capture orders. Procurement flagged "merchant mismatch" and won’t provision until we include it.
Ethan (deal-desk): Can you paste the PO sample? Is this a billing_entity vs merchant_account mismatch or something else?
Diana (ACME Cloud): They sent this example from their side:
```json
{
  "po_id": "PO-3921",
  "billing_entity": "redwood-inc",
  "merchant_account": "acct-ACME-12345"
}
```
Yui (finance): We only emit `billing_entity` in the marketplace PO payload. No `merchant_account` today.
Liam (legal): Also seeing a redline from ACME on refunds — they want a 90-day refund SLA in the vendor terms which conflicts with our standard 30-day consumer refunds. That will block acceptance.
Ethan (deal-desk): Two blockers then: (1) merchant_account not present; (2) refund SLA redline. Partner offered a workaround: accept our `billing_entity` if we sign a one-off merchant alias addendum. Any legal bandwidth to fast-track?
Liam (legal): I can spin up a short addendum limiting refunds to 30 days and excluding chargebacks. If deal desk approves, I can get sign-off today.
Priya (partnerships): @Yui can finance add an optional `merchant_account` field quickly if legal approves the addendum? Ops may need it for merchant whitelisting.
Yui (finance): We can add an optional `merchant_account` to the PO emitter in the next 24–48 hours behind a feature flag. Shorter if we do a manual token for this PO only.
MarketplaceBot: PO PO-3921 status: BLOCKED — awaiting merchant linkage and contract acceptance.
Diana (ACME Cloud): Partner can whitelist a merchant token immediately if we provide one. They need the merchant token in-place before their marketplace sync at 18:00 PT tomorrow.
Ethan (deal-desk): Proposed path: (A) Liam drafts one-off addendum restricting refunds to 30 days; (B) finance issues a temporary merchant token for PO-3921; (C) Priya confirms partner will proceed once token and addendum are in place. Does that work?
Liam (legal): Agreed. I'll draft now — include clause: "Refunds limited to 30 days; no chargebacks; disputes routed to Redwood intent-to-resolve process." Send to me any partner language to avoid drift.
Yui (finance): If legal signs off, I'll issue `merchant_temp_1987` as a one-time merchant token and log it to the deal record.
Priya (partnerships): I'll confirm with ACME ops. Quick note: partner also requested the `merchant_account` to be present in the PO payload for downstream reconciliation. If we can do the manual token now, we can schedule the optional schema change for next sprint.
Diana (ACME Cloud): ACME ops confirmed they'll accept the temporary token and the addendum. They want a Docusign link for the addendum and the merchant token before 16:00 PT tomorrow.
Ethan (deal-desk): I'll prepare the Docusign package once Liam posts the addendum. Priya, can you lock the timeline with partner and copy the marketplace integration doc?
Priya (partnerships): Locked — scheduling 14:00 sync with partner + ops + finance. If we don't have signed addendum + token by 16:00 PT, escalate to VP Partnerships for override. :eyes:
MarketplaceBot: Action log — created case #MP-1987, linked PO-3921, waiting on docs and token.
Yui (finance): I'll provision `merchant_temp_1987` after legal posts the final addendum PDF. Tag me in the doc.
Liam (legal): Draft posted: https://docs.google.com/draft-addendum (internal). Please review asap.
Ethan (deal-desk): Reviewing now. Will route to Docusign once Priya confirms partner contact.
Priya (partnerships): Partner contact confirmed (jane.ops@acmecloud.com). 14:00 sync invite sent. Marking this thread P1 until resolution.
Diana (ACME Cloud): Thanks all. Partner really wants to launch tomorrow — they appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Priya (partnerships): Thanks team — will update thread after 14:00 call.
